{{Quote|The first blade. First Jedi weapon. From this beginning, lightsabers came.|One of the droids guarding the hilt|audio=FirstBladeFirstJediWeapon-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''First Blade''' was an ancient weapon that served as the foundation for all modern [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. It was designed by an ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[Weapon Master]] and kept on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] by [[Tythonian War Droid|droids]] for millennia.

==History==
The First Blade was originally crafted by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] called the [[Weapon Master]] on Tython. During the [[Force Wars]], [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Rajivari]] searched to retrieve the First Blade. He proved worthy of it, and was permitted to take the [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]]. Rajivari heavily engraved the hilt to store information about the location of his [[Fount of Rajivari|secret knowledge reservoir]], and then he returned it to its droid keepers.<ref name="TOR" />

The hilt of the First Blade was recovered by the [[The Barsen'thor|Scorekeeper's Herald]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This Jedi then mounted the hilt into a lightsaber, complete with a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that had been found in the [[Vur Tepe|Tythonian Forge]]. [[Yuon Par]], the Herald's Jedi Master, also thoroughly studied the engravings on the hilt to deduce the coordinates of the [[Fount of Rajivari]] and let her apprentice reach it.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The First Blade was introduced in the [[2011]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of a class-quest for the [[Jedi Consular]].<ref name="TOR" />

''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' established that the First Blade was wielded by Rajivari,<ref name="TOR" /> who died by [[25,783 BBY]],<ref name="date">''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' established that Rajivari died during the [[Force Wars]] and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' says that the Force Wars ended in [[25,783 BBY]].</ref> yet it was not a [[protosaber]],<ref name="TOR" /> despite the fact that the Jedi still wielded protosabers in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Golden1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>
